canonical_title: Costs of Assessment and Assessment Timeframes

one_line_answer.text: Assessment must be affordable. Costs are negotiated with the assessing organization or body.

cites.quote: they must be negotiated with either the assessing organization or body

bangla_explanation: Assessment-এর খরচ সাধ্যের মধ্যে রাখতে হবে, তাই cost আগে থেকে negotiate করা হয়।
Workplace-এ assessment হলে candidate-কে কাজ থেকে সরাতে হয়, এটাও একটা খরচ।
একসাথে একাধিক candidate, clustered units-এর projects, আর feedback হিসেবেও চলে এমন checklists খরচ কমায়।
Timeframe আগে থেকে estimated ও planned রাখো, যাতে learner ready থাকে।

example.en: A welding centre assesses five candidates in one session. Its checklist also records feedback.
example.bn: এক session-এ পাঁচজন, আর একই checklist দিয়ে feedback, খরচ কমলো।

list_answer.title: Ways to make assessment cost effective

items.text: Use methods that assess more than one candidate at a time, where appropriate.

cites.quote: use methods which will allow you to assess more than one candidate at a time, where appropriate

items.text: Choose methods that assess clustered units of competency, such as projects.

cites.quote: choose methods which assess clustered units of competency, such as projects

items.text: Design checklists for more than one function. Recording tools can double as feedback tools.

cites.quote: design checklists so that they fulfill more than one function, recording tools can double as feedback tools

items.text: Consider tools that are already available, and modify them if necessary.

cites.quote: consider tools that are already available (consider modifying available tools, if necessary)

items_bn: সম্ভব হলে এমন methods নাও যাতে একসাথে একাধিক candidate assess করা যায়; এতে সময় ও খরচ দুটোই কমে।
Projects-এর মতো methods বেছে নাও, যাতে আলাদা আলাদা নয়, একবারে clustered units of competency assess হয়।
একটা checklist যেন একাধিক কাজ করে — যেমন recording tools-ই আবার feedback tools হিসেবে ব্যবহার হয়।
নতুন বানানোর আগে হাতে থাকা tools দেখো; দরকার হলে সেগুলো modify করে নাও, এতে খরচ বাঁচে।

traps.text: In the workplace, candidates and others may be taken off work activities.

cites.quote: candidates and others might need to be taken off work activities to undertake the assessment

traps.text: Timing is estimated and planned so the learner is ready and arrangements are made.

cites.quote: The timing of assessment events need to be estimated and planned to ensure that the learner is ready and that all relevant arrangements have been made

short.prompt: How can you make assessment methods and tools cost-effective?
short.modelAnswer:
Assessment must be affordable, and costs are negotiated with the assessing organization. To be cost-effective:
1. Assess more than one candidate at a time.
2. Assess clustered units, such as projects.
3. Design checklists with more than one function.
4. Use or modify tools already available.
